Convert a dependency graph to node/edge data frames

Source: R/graph-data.R
bw_graph_data.Rd

Produces the nodes and edges data frames used by the Shiny dashboard (and anything else that wants to draw the DAG, e.g. visNetwork). Nodes are grouped and coloured by source, with referenced-but-missing packages highlighted.

Usage

bw_graph_data(graph)

Arguments

graph

A bw_depgraph/igraph from build_dep_graph().

Value

A list with two tibbles:

  • nodes: id, label, group (source), present, title (HTML tooltip), color.

  • edges: from, to, constraint, arrows.

Examples

gd <- bw_graph_data(build_dep_graph(bw_example("clean.lock")))
gd$nodes
